policy_adopted: A real DART IOMapper before any DMA; no automatic bypass (root decision; my earlier bypass option withdrawn). Linux corroborates: the Wi-Fi iommu_group type is DMA (translated), with 1 MSI vector (runs/m1-desktop-010/wifi-iommu-inventory.json).
primary_sources: sources/linux-aurora-platform-reference (pcie-apple.c, apple-dart.c, io-pgtable-dart.c at 6a08a08e). Native ground truth: private ADT (topology only, identifiers redacted). PureDarwin e7aa00a IOPCIFamily and XNU IOMapper. Secondary only: a local Asahi-derived t8103 DT for the pwren and iommu-map cross-check, to be replaced by acquired pinned DT files.

adt_ground_truth.apcie: compatible apcie,t8103; #ports 3; bus-range 0..8. reg: ECAM 0x690000000+0x10000000, rc 0x680000000, PHY common 0x680080000; port0 core 0x681000000+0x8000, LTSSM 0x681010000, PHY 0x680084000, PHY-IP 0x6800c8000, intr2axi 0x68100c000 (ports 1/2 at 0x682/0x683...). Port interrupts AIC 695/698/701; MSI window msi-vector-offset 0x2c0 (AIC 704), #msi-vectors 32; msi-address 0xfffff000; power and clock gates 0x4d APCIE (0x23b700348, parent IMX critical), 0x61 APCIE_GP (0x23b7003e8, parent APCIE), 0x1d PCIE_REF (0x23b7001a0). All three are ADT default-on and none is hooked by m1n1's HV.
adt_ground_truth.pci_bridge0: apcie-port 0; msi-vector-base 0, #msi-vectors 8; function-perst AP GPIO 152; function-clkreq AP GPIO 150; maximum-link-speed 2; t-refclk-to-perst 100; perst-to-config 100; dart_request_sid/release_sid/force_active/self functions pointing at dart-apcie0 (macOS assigns SIDs dynamically). Children: wlan and bluetooth-pcie.
adt_ground_truth.wlan: compatible wlan-pcie,bcm4378; iommu-parent 0x50 = dart-apcie0/mapper-apcie0-wlan; ASPM default 2. No power function in the ADT.
adt_ground_truth.dart_apcie0: compatible dart,t8020 at 0x681008000+0x4000; interrupt AIC 696; page-size 16 KiB; vm-base 0x00100000, vm-size 0xbfe00000; dart-options 0x17; mappers mapper-apcie0-wlan 0x50 and mapper-apcie0-bt 0x51.
adt_ground_truth.wifi_power: Not in the ADT bridge or wlan nodes. The Linux DT (secondary) uses port00 pwren-gpios = <&smc_gpio 13>: an SMC coprocessor GPIO.

ownership_model.plan: Same pattern as the keyboard adapter: verify target and actual 0xf, refuse on RESET/DISABLE, never power down a parent. Not HV-hooked.

ownership_model.resource: ADT apcie-* tunables, refclk, link bring-up
ownership_model.owner: host m1n1 pcie_init (MIT) before HV start, root-owned
ownership_model.plan: Phase 1: host P_PCIE_INIT (already exposed, unused on the HV path). Phase 2, optional: port pcie.c/tunables.c into the driver. pcie-apple.c's refclk REQ/ACK, APPCLK, PORT_STATUS ready and LTSSM sequence is the behavioural reference.

PureDarwin has no SMC/RTKit/mailbox driver. Options: (a) prove it is already on at handoff; (b) host-side m1n1 smc.c/rtkit.c (MIT) before HV start; (c) a native SMC driver, later. Never toggle blindly. t8103 has no pwren off-cycle (pwren_off_ms 0).

ownership_model.resource: PERST# (AP GPIO 152 plus PORT_PERST 0x814) and CLKREQ (AP GPIO 150)
ownership_model.plan: pcie-apple.c sequence: assert PERST, pwren on, refclk handshake, wait 100 ms, deassert, wait 100 ms, poll PORT_STATUS ready. Read back pin words and refuse on LOCK, as the keyboard adapter does.
Standard ECAM at 0x690000000 for t8103 (pci_ecam_map_bus). The root port is bus 0 slot = port index; port 0's secondary bus is 1. Reuse PureDarwin PDArmPCI's ECAM structure, not its generic match.
Mask all (PORT_INTMSK ~0), clear INTSTAT/LINKCMDSTS, then unmask link-up and errors. LTSSM start (PORT_LTSSMCTL 0x80), wait for PORT_INT_LINK_UP. Log RID2SID_MAPERR, MSI_ERR, CPL_TIMEOUT.

PORT_MSIADDR(0x168)=0xfffff000, PORT_MSIBASE(0x128)=0, PORT_MSICFG(0x124)=log2(32)<<4|EN. Allocate MSI data only inside port0's ADT slice 0..7, message address 0xfffff000 and data = vector, delivered as AIC 704+data. MUST NOT fall through to IOPCIBridge's x86 family MSI controller (IOPCIBridge.cpp:4016-4021), which would program an x86 doorbell on arm64.

ownership_model.owner: native apcie driver, per enabled device
ownership_model.plan: Probe the slot count with 0xbad1d, then clear all slots. On enable write VALID|sid<<16|rid and read back; clear on disable. SID choice: Linux maps all of bus 1 to SID 1 (iommu-map-mask 0xff00, Wi-Fi and BT share a stream); the ADT models separate wlan/bt mappers with dynamic SIDs. Start with Wi-Fi only on a fixed SID matching the mapper, recorded explicitly.

Publish IOMapperID = 0x50 (wlan mapper phandle) so IOMapper::copyMapperForDevice() finds it through the wlan nub's iommu-parent (IOMapper.cpp:174-205). Implement initHardware, getPageSize (16 KiB), iovmMapMemory, iovmUnmapMemory, iovmInsert and mapToPhysicalAddress over the io-pgtable-dart format (36-bit OA, 16 KiB pages, PTE valid bit 0, PA mask 35:12, NO_READ bit 8, NO_WRITE bit 7, subpage start/end fields). Per stream: TCR (0x100+4*sid) TRANSLATE_ENABLE, 4 TTBRs (0x200 + 0x10*sid + 4*i) with VALID. STREAMS_ENABLE 0xfc. Invalidate via STREAM_SELECT 0x34 plus STREAM_COMMAND 0x20 INVALIDATE, polling BUSY. Fault IRQ AIC 696 reads ERROR 0x40 and ADDR 0x50/0x54. Refuse if CONFIG 0x60 LOCK is set (firmware-owned). Allocate IOVA only inside vm-base/vm-size and never in the doorbell page 0xfffff000 (apple-dart.c:2631-2645 IOMMU_RESV_MSI).

Confirm PureDarwin IOPCIBridge attaches the discovered 14e4:4425 function to apcie/pci-bridge0/wlan so iommu-parent 0x50 appears on the nub; otherwise the host bridge must set it. A Wi-Fi driver must use IODMACommand with that device's mapper; no raw physical DMA.

risks: x86 MSI fallback on arm64 (a wrong doorbell causes DART faults or stray writes); the platform hook must exist before enabling MSI.
Locked or firmware-owned DART streams; read CONFIG lock first.
Unproven Wi-Fi power at handoff; the SMC dependency is the largest new subsystem.
HV interplay: apcie and dart ranges are passthrough (arm-io mapped HW, not hooked), so PERST or link errors hit real hardware. The BT function shares the port and must stay untouched (excluded).
attempt-003-style host stalls: any first PCIe experiment should be enumeration-only and read back every write, like the keyboard path.
next_minimal_pins_to_acquire: arch/arm64/boot/dts/apple/t8103.dtsi, t8103-jxxx.dtsi, t8103-j293.dts (pwren, iommu-map and port wiring at 6a08)
optional, if the SMC route is chosen: drivers/soc/apple/rtkit*.c, drivers/mailbox/apple-mailbox.c, drivers/mfd/macsmc.c, drivers/gpio/gpio-macsmc.c (m1n1's MIT asc.c/rtkit.c/smc.c are already local)
safe_readonly_inventory_additions: /sys/kernel/debug/gpio lines for the smc-gpio chip, line 13 direction and level only (answers whether Wi-Fi power is high under Linux)
/proc/interrupts rows matching apple-pcie, apple-dart or brcmf (AIC numbers and counts)
staged_first_experiment_shape: Host P_PCIE_INIT, then a native read-only host bridge: verify PMGR, read PORT_STATUS/LINKSTS, read ECAM vendor and device of bus 1 dev 0 fn 0 (expect 14e4:4425), with no MSI enable, no RID2SID, no DART and no driver bind. Stop. The Linux recovery rule is unchanged.
not_claimed: No source edits, builds, firmware, PCIe init or hardware access.
